profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer with experience building applications using Ruby on Rails, Python/Django, and PHP/Symfony.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with multiple teams to migrate all users and products from Tradesy to Vestiaire Collective
- Built an inventory management system using Python/Django that served clients with hundreds of thousands of products
- Integrated with third-party partners to gain access to high-quality products
- Developed internal tools using PHP/Python that allow our product team to easily update content and promotional banners

positions.title: Freelancer
positions.description: I am currently developing web applications on a contract basis using Ruby and Python.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Built an end-to-end test suite using selenium web driver
- Built a double-entry bookkeeping system to track financing for clients
- Collaborated with other engineers to build a pricing data tool that allows buyers/sellers to check daily/weekly pricing

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Mentored junior engineers
- Built internal application using ReactJS
- Converted Ruby on Rails application to a RESTful API using the Grape API framework
- Improved applications performance by identifying and optimizing slow transactions
- Reduced runtime of test automation suite by an order of magnitude
- Setup and optimized test automation build process using Jenkins

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Loot Crate is a monthly subscription service for geeks and gamers (me!).

- Built a full test suite, and refactored a 2-year-old legacy application
- Improved application's overall performance on the front-end and backend
- Engineered many of Loot Crate’s customer and admin features
- Launched and contributed to multiple launches of new products
- Worked closely with marketing, business intelligence, operations, and customer support team
- Integrated and contributed to integrations of Chargify, Recurly, ShipStation, Mandrill, MailChimp, Avalara’s AvaTax, Friendbuy, ZenDesk, SmartyStreets, MixPanel, ID.me, Fast.ly, and Tealium

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Payment Gateway (Ruby on Rails):
API to accepts and handles fiat payments from customers. Allow admins to view purchases, and perform other admin tasks.

Marketing Application (Laravel):
Migrated existing codebase to the Laravel framework and OctoberCMS.
Built admin and promotional tools for non-technical team members to use.
Structured content creation tools to optimize for SEO.

Accounts Application (Laravel):
Worked with lead developer to fix bugs.
Integrated analytics (Mixpanel, Awe.sm, CampaignEQ, Segment.io).

Agents Portal (Laravel):
Portal for expresscoin's agents to manage their balances, and perform other admin tasks.
